_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for the settings area. Settings and per-radio configuration. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. A key whose text is missing is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. LADDERS: a key may hold three tiers instead of one string - critical, terse and chatty - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. This partition is empty; the extraction tracks fill it. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.

settings.radio.restart.started: Restarting. The radio will be unreachable for a few minutes, then you can connect again.
settings.radio.unregister.cancelled: Cancelled. The radio is still registered.
settings.radio.unregister.confirm_body: JJ Flex will remove this radio's SmartLink registration. You will not be able to reach it from away from home until it is registered again.
settings.radio.unregister.confirm_questi: This is almost never what you want. Continue?
settings.radio.unregister.warning_needs_: Registering again requires someone to key the microphone or CW key at the radio. There is no remote way to do it.
settings.radio.unregister.warning_strand: If this radio is somewhere you cannot get to, unregistering it means you cannot get it back without travelling there or asking someone on site.
settings.radio.way_in.not_set: Not set. No port is forwarded on the radio. {modeText} If the router cannot be changed, allow hole-punch in Network settings and check it with step 6.
settings.radio.way_in.ports_separate: external TCP port {tcp} and UDP port {udp}
settings.radio.way_in.set: Set on the radio. It advertises {ports}. {modeText} Your router still needs the two rules — external TCP {tcp} to the radio's LAN IP port {tlsPort}, and external UDP {udpShown} to port {udpPort} — JJ Flex cannot do that part. Step 6 checks whether it worked.
settings.updates.nightly_confirm_body: Nightly builds come straight from the latest overnight compile. They include the freshest fixes but can also include brand-new bugs, and you may need to pick up the pieces if something goes wrong.
settings.updates.server_unreachable: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your network connection.
settings.updates.up_to_date: You're up to date on the {channel} channel.
settings.watt_meter.must_select_port: You must select a COM port.
settings.watt_meter.must_select_power_ty: You must select a power type.
settings.watt_meter.must_select_usage: You must select a usage mode.
